cover_headline: Plaintiffs Push for Fast Ruling in $100,000 H-1B Fee Case as Government Seeks Pause

end.headline: Plaintiffs Push for Fast Ruling in $100,000 H-1B Fee Case as Government Seeks Pause
end.line: In Global Nurse Force v. Trump, plaintiffs want a fast final ruling on the $100,000 fee, while the government seeks a pause until the Ninth Circuit rules on its appeal.

facts: Judge Gilliam's September 30 order already blocks the fee policies, and a separate Massachusetts injunction also bars collection
Plaintiffs proposed that the government produce the administrative record by November 3, the first step toward summary judgment
The stay motion itself is set for a hearing on January 14, 2027
